actual_source.list: testfarm.api.units→core.project.list_units executes configured LIST, requires hang guard, parses source-format lines/JSONL, rejects duplicate/invalid IDs and empty results unless allowed. spawn.run_confined uses source read-only/scratch-only write/allowlist env/network deny; actual OS confinement remains separately proved, not inferred from Policy DTO.
actual_source.run_templates: model.config.RunSpec holds argv/ids_after/slice/results/env/launcher/needs; schema/kinds validates array tokens, no shell string, no program placeholder, whole-argument ids/extra. parse requires {ids} or {idfile} with LIST and slice index/count rules. Source config validation is not execution authority.
actual_source.implementation_gap: No general testfarm RunSpec.argv expansion/execution consumer was found in inspected testfarm/scripts source. Its rich schema is retained evidence, not an implemented canonical runner. scripts/test.pytest_command and actual testslots runner are the maintained pytest execution path; proposed profile needs its real native adapter.
actual_source.selection: core.select.select accepts sets/globs and empty selectors select all. Canonical intent DOES NOT reuse that broad/default selection policy; one nonempty exact name only, no suite alias or fallback.
actual_source.ids: model.ids.refusal uses NFC, rejects controls/private-use/unassigned categories and leading dash/prefix restrictions. Parameterized pytest punctuation is legitimate. Plain selector remains ordinary data, not a source path, argv or authority.
actual_source.report: Existing testreuse_run reads per-case JUnit counts and testfarm.report summarizes results. Tests/repository plugins can forge these reports. A canonical receipt proves exact admitted execution/exit provenance, not correctness, honesty or security quality of repository code.

intended_design.plain_selector: JobManagedTestUnitIntent accepts source lookup ref and a direct TestingExactSelector string. No native-text/input reference, GUI ritual, project registration or terminal step is required to name a unit. Nonempty UTF-8 uses the existing canonical 65536-byte per-text wire envelope, not a claim that legacy IDs had that limit; IDs outside the supported transport/profile refuse explicitly, not truncate or gain a hidden staging ceremony. Resolve exact equality to one catalogue Unit.name (with its grouped IDs) in immutable discovery; no match/ambiguity refuses. Punctuation such as brackets or * in a parameter ID is literal data, never glob/shell expansion. Empty selection and suite-wide aliases have no fallback; an all/glob-looking value never selects a set.
intended_design.source_authority: TestingSourceRef is installation/principal/incarnation-bound lookup data for the actual current-source snapshot, not proof of access or execution rights. A genuine native source/current-directory adapter must hold and verify file identities/content including selected dirty/untracked code and exact allowed dependencies under existing source/OS policy. No mandatory workspace/project/board. Do not introduce blanket signed-source or person approval for authorized ordinary local code; signatures/OS consent only where actual policy requires. Ref/digest/profile/caller label never grants execution.
intended_design.direct_vs_managed: Direct pytest/library/testfarm config or units calls retain ordinary local behavior and require no Node/daemon/session/claim. This leaf governs ONLY explicitly requested managed Node execution; it must not become a pre-tool gate or intercept generic testing.
intended_design.profile: Exactly maintained_pytest_explicit_unit_v1, a node-owned reviewed profile bound to concrete supported LIST/RUN token arrays and held Python/pytest/executable/plugin/config/environment bytes. Recognize frozen template grammar and toolchain before any code. Run chosen frozen IDs as separate whole arguments through the one existing admitted worker path; never shell-parse, accept caller extras, program interpolation, arbitrary env or evaluate JSON/config as a command. Only fixed profile-provided result-sink and ID-file locations under node-owned scratch may be substituted. Unknown custom templates, presets, hooks, steps, launchers, slices, unsupported flags or report formats refuse as unsupported; do not silently ignore them or construct a generic/fake executor.
intended_design.admission_before_collection: LIST/pytest collection imports repository code, plugins and conftest and can have effects. Require normal managed execution permission and actual CPU/memory/storage/process/output/native confinement admission BEFORE source scan/collection/staging. Freeze a private JobFrozenTestingCollectionPlan with collection launch transaction/fence before execution; no fabricated already-known unit catalogue. Hold source read-only, isolated home/temp and immutable environment, deny real keystore/home/paid API/public network. Source LIST output_bytes=None is a gap; a real resource profile must provide admitted aggregate output/parse limits before enablement, no hidden unbounded buffer or invented success. The precollection plan freezes actual timeout/output/confinement/resource-profile defaults before LIST, not by resolving them after collection; its digest binds the actual held policy.
intended_design.network_and_models: Network denied by default. Loopback only through a separately reviewed exact resource profile/endpoint binding; no public endpoint/DNS/proxy/provider access or sandbox weakening. A model-backed collection or run requires real admitted model/backend and authoritative lease before any model use; unavailable or unknown needs refuse loudly, no fake model/mock answer. Ordinary claim holds are not compute permits. Missing OS enforcement or model-resource closure cannot be replaced by a label or boolean.
intended_design.freeze_after_collection: After one admitted collection, freeze actual source/config/toolchain/environment/plugins/dependency/confinement digests, exact collector profile/generation/result, full unique unit/grouped ID order+digest, selector, real resource bounds and explicit hang guards. Dynamic dependency claims in LIST output cannot narrow actual code-trust/read scope or a reuse key without verified closure; absent dependency metadata conservatively binds whole held source. Match source/generation at every phase; current-source does not mean a mutable live path. No whole suite default.
intended_design.durability: Reuse the same principal+installation incarnation+operation+RequestId+normalized intent ledger. Same request attaches on exact payload; conflict refuses before code. One collection fence before LIST, separate run fence before submit execution, separate result-publication transaction. A prepared run binds its exact original collection plan digest. Same plan/new RequestId cannot recollect/rerun or remint work after lost ack; unresolved source/selector operation blocks retry bypass. An explicit new run after settled prior outcome may use a new request; do not turn read/inspect into execution.
intended_design.submit: Reauthorize before replay and action; recheck held source/toolchain/profile/environment/plugins/dependency/config/unit/resource/custody generations and expiry, then launch only exact frozen IDs. Runtime pytest collection must match the frozen selection/grouped IDs; changed/extra/missing IDs or dynamic configuration cannot broaden selection. Profile timeout must be an actual finite positive source/policy limit, not a retry knob. Unknown template/profile/estimate/confinement/admission refuses, including collection or model imports.
intended_design.cancel_recovery: Before collection or run fence, cancellation wins atomically with that launch. During collection/run, use the owned confined process-tree cancellation path and retain output/resource custody until actual descendant termination/reap and settlement. Timeout is timed_out/error, never pass; missing termination evidence remains unknown/recovery, not a false cancelled terminal. Crash/ack loss retains exact operation/source/fences/holders and reconciles; no blind recollect/rerun, generic PID kill or silent retry on another node.
intended_design.reports_and_results: Project/repository code can forge JUnit, counts and passed output. reported_outcome and report_status are explicitly untrusted source observations. Execution receipt itself needs actual protected/native producer+process/source/runtime/confinement proof. Enforce exact IDs/counts and parser-profile boundaries, aggregate output admission and redaction before persistence/streaming. Missing/malformed/conflicting report→error/unknown; skipped is never passed; exit/report conflict cannot become pass. Publish result only after actual exit/owned output custody. Optional report_digest is absent when no report exists, never invented.
intended_design.reuse: Reuse only actual immutable receipt under exactly equal source/config/toolchain/environment/plugins/dependency closure/selection/native runtime/confinement and current authorization/resource policy. Current source must be freshly verified against retained bytes; do not trust old hash labels or arbitrary dependency claims. Expose original receipt explicitly, never pretend cached execution ran again. Any uncertainty/unknown effect refuses reuse. Compare every required actual current native/runtime/confinement/toolchain/config/plugin/dependency/selection identity independently; the two public current digest fields alone are never sufficient for reuse.
intended_design.streaming: Use existing jobs output and ordered preparation watch with principal/installation/job/generation-bound cursors and bounded redacted chunks. Disconnect detaches only; no cancellation, new collection, project registration or automatic callback execution.
